"Weird Al" Yankovic: The Ultimate Video Collection
is a compilation of videos by the American parody artist and satirist
"Weird Al" Yankovic
. The DVD included music videos from tracks for every album released up until the point of the DVD's release.
Release
The DVD was released with a few bonus features such as a photo gallery and
5.1 surround sound
.
[
1
]
It also includes an
Easter egg
of an unofficial music video for "
My Bologna
."
